name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Replays jump taps you made just before landing or touching an orb, and delays ship, wave and swing inputs a few ticks when they would crash. One slider sets the strength for every game mode.

ticks.name: Buffer ticks
ticks.description: One slider for every game mode. How early a tap can still count (cube, ball, robot, spider, UFO) and the most a ship, wave or swing input may be delayed. 1 tick = 1/240 s, so 4 ticks is about 1 frame at 60 FPS. 0 turns the mod off.

buffer-rings.name: Buffer orbs
buffer-rings.description: Also replay taps made just before touching an orb or ring.

show-counter.name: Show replay counter
show-counter.description: Shows how many taps were replayed (this attempt and in total) at the bottom of the screen.

practice-only.name: Practice mode only
practice-only.description: Turn the whole mod off outside practice mode.

assist-enabled.name: Ship, wave & swing assist
assist-enabled.description: Looks a few ticks ahead and, if a ship, wave or swing press/release would crash, delivers it later instead (up to the Buffer ticks limit). Skipped in platformer, and whenever the look-ahead hits an orb, pad, trigger or portal.

assist-dual.name: Assist in dual mode
assist-dual.description: Also run the ship/wave/swing assist in dual mode, holding back both players' inputs together. Off by default because it is the least tested part.

assist-margin.name: Required safe ticks
assist-margin.description: After the tick where your raw input would crash, a delayed input must keep the hidden player alive this many ticks longer to count as a save. Higher = stricter, fewer but safer saves.

assist-budget-ms.name: Look-ahead time budget (ms)
assist-budget-ms.description: If the look-ahead takes longer than this for one input, it is abandoned and your input passes through. Lower it if you notice lag.

assist-autopause.name: Pause assist when it keeps failing
assist-autopause.description: If most of the saves on a level are followed by a crash (for example because of moving objects the look-ahead can't see), pause the assist for the rest of that level.

assist-pause-with.name: Pause assist with these mods
assist-pause-with.description: Mod IDs, separated by commas. The ship/wave/swing assist stays off while any of them is enabled. Use this if another mod reacts to the hidden player.
